Name: Eriagon's Journal
Description:
Entry 1:
My brother, Eriagon, who is not so enthused with all of my ideas has insisted that I keep a journal. Do not allow his skepticism to deceive you, dear reader. If you have found this journal, then you are in luck - for I, the great Tarhiel, have discovered a dark secret long hidden from this world: the gift of flight!

Not long ago, I was attending to some important business in Vivec. Naturally, I took a Silt Strider to Balmora where I'd finish the journey to Vivec. You wouldn't believe my fury when the nasty bug got lost along the way - and with such a simple trip!

When I finally arrived in Balmora, it was too late! The meeting had already passed. It was then in my frustration - in that glorious inn that I had a brilliant epiphany! Imagine the gods, laughing at our folly. We wander around on our tiny legs from place to place. At times, we beg the Silt Strider to spare her back that we might scurry a little faster. Imagine if instead we could fly on the tops of Cliff Racers. Wretched creatures!

That's when it hit me! You see, the business I had in Vivec, was to sell scrolls of a very potent form of the Feather alteration spell. But what if there was a way to harness this recipe for flight instead. Perhaps a powerful jump would do the trick! Yes, that might work...

Entry 2:
It has been three weeks. Three weeks of reading, tinkering, and experimenting, but I finally have it! This whole town thinks I've gone mad! Admittedly, I have not eaten in days now, but we will see who is laughing when I, the great Tarhiel, gift them with the power of flight! I'll call it - the Scrolls of Icarian Flight! Yes, that's it!

Now I must leave this place and go somewhere far away to test this scroll. Somewhere where my brother and this town cannot laugh at me if my experiment fails... I've got it! I will travel to Seyda Neen. Wish me luck!

Entry 3:
I cannot believe what I am reading. This could not have been my brother. Not Tarhiel! Oh what a stupid fool he has been! To test this wretched scroll on himself! To make matters worse, some sap-sucker has stolen his scroll and scattered his belongings! I am beside myself. I will rest here at Arrille's Tradehouse, then I will head to Balmora for answers. Perhaps my brother found inspiration from a local while he was stranded.

Entry 4:
One thing I cannot stop thinking about is what happened to the scroll. Had my brother truly created something special? What if someone powerful stole it from him? Or what if they hired someone to steal it from them? Even if I have to risk my own life, I've got to find that scroll. It's my brother's legacy!

Entry 5:
I overheard from a few locals that the South Wall Cornerclub is a place where thieves and branchless degenerates go to do business. One local was kind enough to accompany me, so I could eavesdrop without detection.

While I was there, I overheard a Dunmer discussing some kind of magic that sounded oddly similar to what my brother describes he used to create the Scrolls of Icarian Flight. The rumor is, there are a few mages - scouts, set up all across Tamriel. They sit in inns and taverns - watching, listening, searching for men and mer with the right talents. Was my brother one of those people? Was he discovered?

The owner of this place, Sugar-Lips Habasi who knew my associate was kind enough to answer my question. She told me that if I wanted to find more information about this mage, I should visit Lucky Lockup and ask people there about Tarhiel and the Scroll.

Entry 6:
I've spent every day the last week at Lucky Lockup. I was about to give up hope until one evening I saw a very strange-looking Altmer with his hood drawn. I decided to speak to the table next to him about the Scrolls of Icarian Flight. Then I paid for my ale and left abruptly.

Sure enough, the Altmer was behind me until it was just him and I. I stopped and allowed him to catch up. He told me that if I was to find answers, I must go to The Merchant's Inn. There I will find another hooded Altmer who can tell me more about Tarhiel.
